footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Invesco: includes a $205M income tax benefit; after $552M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 5.1% to $6.4B in 2025. The company had an operating loss of $696M, versus operating income of $832M.

The company had a net loss of $726M, or −$1.60 per share, versus net income of $538M. Operating cash flow was $1.5B and free cash flow $1.4B, versus $1.1B; Invesco returned $501M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Invesco Ltd. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
